title: Affine pullback section equivalence requiring quasi-coherence only on the chosen open
statement: Let $i:Z\to Y$ be an affine morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], [pqf-def-affine-morphism], $U$ an affine open of $Y$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], $V=i^{-1}U$, $A=\Gamma(Y,U)$, and $B=\Gamma(Z,V)$, with the $A$-algebra structure from $i^\sharp_U$. Let $G$ be a module sheaf on $Y$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] such that $G|_U$ [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits] is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent]. There exists a $B$-linear equivalence $$e:B\otimes_A G(U)\simeq(P_iG)(V),$$ where $P_i$ is tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] and the tensor product is [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. For every $b\in B$ and $s\in G(U)$ it satisfies $e(b\otimes s)=b\cdot\eta_{i,G,U}(s)$, where $\eta_i$ is the chosen canonical tensor-pullback adjunction unit [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. No quasi-coherence of $G$ outside $U$ or quasi-separatedness of $Y$ is assumed.

proof.text: V is affine. Restrict G along the canonical Spec A chart of U. This restriction factors as restriction to U followed by restriction along its chart isomorphism, so it is quasi-coherent. Its global sections identify with G(U).

The canonical Spec B to Spec A ring-map square gives a comparison between the two composites of chart restriction and standard module pullback. Compose the proved source-library pullbackSpecGammaEquiv with this comparison and the section identifications. The affineChart_pullback_unit theorem calculates the composite on one tensor s. TensorPullback and standard pullback are the two left adjoints to the same pushforward; their uniqueness unit equation transfers this calculation to the specified tensor pullback.

Construct the canonical map s tensor b to b times the tensor-pullback unit using TensorProduct.lift and the semilinearity of the unit. Tensor induction shows that this map agrees with the preceding composite of bijections, hence is bijective. Swap tensor factors. Tensor induction using the same pure-tensor formula proves B-linearity. Package the map as LinearEquiv.ofBijective. No point or nonempty-open choice is made.

theorem exists_locallyQuasicoherent_affine_pullback_sections
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom i]
    (U : Y.affineOpens) (G : Y.Modules) (hG : (G.restrict U.1.ι).IsQuasicoherent) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(Y, U.1) Γ(Z, i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) := (i.app U.1).hom.toAlgebra
    ∃ e : (Γ(Z, i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ⊗[Γ(Y, U.1)] G.val.obj (op U.1)) ≃ₗ[Γ(Z, i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)]
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj G).val.obj (op (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)),
      ∀ (b : Γ(Z, i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)) (s : G.val.obj (op U.1)),
        e (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(Y, U.1)] s) = b •
          (show ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj G).val.obj (op (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)) from
            ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction i)).unit.app
            G).val.app (op U.1) s)
